image_description: A close-up shot of two chestnut/sorrel horses standing side-by-side. The horse in the foreground is wearing a white halter and has a white blaze on its face. Both horses have reddish-brown coats with lighter, flaxen manes. A portion of a third horse or object is visible on the far left edge. The background shows a wooden fence and some vegetation.
